CVE-2023-22665.title: There is insufficient checking of user queries in Apache Jena ver ...
CVE-2023-22665.description: There is insufficient checking of user queries in Apache Jena versions 4.7.0 and earlier, when invoking custom scripts. It allows a remote user to execute arbitrary javascript via a SPARQL query.

CVE-2023-32200.title: There is insufficient restrictions of called script functions in  ...
CVE-2023-32200.description:
There is insufficient restrictions of called script functions in Apache Jena
 versions 4.8.0 and earlier. It allows a 
remote user to execute javascript via a SPARQL query.
This issue affects Apache Jena: from 3.7.0 through 4.8.0.

CVE-2025-49656.title: Users with administrator access can create databases files outsid ...
CVE-2025-49656.description:
Users with administrator access can create databases files outside the files area of the Fuseki server.

This issue affects Apache Jena version up to 5.4.0.

Users are recommended to upgrade to version 5.5.0, which fixes the issue.

CVE-2025-50151.title: File access paths in configuration files uploaded by users with a ...
CVE-2025-50151.description:
File access paths in configuration files uploaded by users with administrator access are not validated.

This issue affects Apache Jena version up to 5.4.0.

Users are recommended to upgrade to version 5.5.0, which does not allow arbitrary configuration upload.

CVE-2026-103333.title: Improper input validation in some SPARQL functions available in A ...
CVE-2026-103333.description:
Improper input validation in some SPARQL functions available in Apache Jena ARQ allows users to submit SPARQL queries that cause excessive CPU and/or memory usage.  This may be the result of intentionally malicious inputs in the query itself, or an expression applied over data that has been insufficiently validated/sanitised

Users are recommended to upgrade to version 6.3.0, which fixes this issue.

CVE-2026-120502.title: A vulnerability in Apache Jena can cause excess memory allocation ...
CVE-2026-120502.description:
A vulnerability in Apache Jena can cause excess memory allocation from malicious Thrift data.



This issue affects Apache Jena: through 6.2.0.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 6.3.0, which fixes the issue.

CVE-2026-124324.title: A vulnerability in Apache Jena Fuseki allows SERVICE operations t ...
CVE-2026-124324.description:
A vulnerability in Apache Jena Fuseki allows SERVICE operations to bypass restrictions on administration operations.



This issue affects Apache Jena Fuseki: from through 6.2.0.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 6.3.0, which fixes the issue.

CVE-2026-61372.title: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Pat ...
CVE-2026-61372.description:
Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal') vulnerability in Apache Jena Fuseki.

This issue affects Apache Jena Fuseki: through 6.1.0.

Users are recommended to upgrade to version 6.2.0, which fixes the issue.

CVE-2026-86154.title: A vulnerability in Apache Jena allows arbitrary stack usage when  ...
CVE-2026-86154.description:
A vulnerability in Apache Jena allows arbitrary stack usage when parsing RDF Turtle-family languages.



This issue affects Apache Jena: through 6.2.0.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 6.3.0, which fixes the issue.

CVE-2026-86155.title: A vulnerability in Apache Jena Fuseki in the SHACL validation fun ...
CVE-2026-86155.description:
A vulnerability in Apache Jena Fuseki in the SHACL validation functionality cause server side request forgery (SSRF).



This issue affects Apache Jena Fuseki: through 6.2.0.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 6.3.0, which fixes the issue.

CVE-2026-86156.title: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Pat ...
CVE-2026-86156.description:
Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal') can allow  SPARQL Update to access data from local server.



This issue affects Apache Jena Fuseki through 6.2.0.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 6.3.0, which fixes the issue.

CVE-2026-97893.title: A Denial of Service (DoS) vulnerability exists in the ARQ SPARQL  ...
CVE-2026-97893.description:
A Denial of Service (DoS) vulnerability exists in the ARQ SPARQL Query Optimiser in Apache Jena ARQ prior to version 6.3.0 that allows a SPARQL query to use that cause excessive memory usage.
Users are recommended to upgrade to version 6.3.0, which fixes this issue.






Users who are unable to upgrade immediately, especially those who operate a public facing SPARQL service/application backed by Apache Jena are recommended to configure the ARQ symbol arq:optPathFlatten=false in their SPARQL execution context which disables the problematic optimisation.
